exposure: Red blood cell distribution width coefficient of variation (RDW-CV)
cohort: The study included 803 neonates, at least 35 weeks of gestation, who were diagnosed with neonatal hyperbilirubinemia (NHB).
finding: Red blood cell distribution width coefficient of variation (RDW-CV) is an independent predictor of bilirubin clearance in neonatal hyperbilirubinemia (NHB), exhibiting a linear dose-response effect.
cross-section timing: RDW-CV was measured at admission, and bilirubin decline velocity was calculated during phototherapy.
